facts.text: Master, I only borrowed the hat to help with supper. The brooms fetched water for the soup, and now, well, there is a lot of soup.
facts.why: Mickey's only spoken lines are at the end, when he congratulates Mr. Stokowski. The quote page has nothing like this, and the brooms carry water for a cistern, not soup. Fine as a note, wrong as a quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: Master, I only borrowed the hat. The brooms were fetching water, and now, well, there is a lot of water.
